description: Open a deep link (such as myapp://item/3) in the running app, as a push tap, auth callback or share link would. Fails with invalid_url if the text has no scheme, or no_handler if apps declare URL schemes and none matches; a match returns the owning app id. Otherwise fails with no_url_listener if the app does not listen for URLs.

url.description: The URL to deliver, e.g. myapp://item/3

name: open_url
